hooks.command: repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); checklist_path="$repo_root/docs/REGRESSION_HYGIENE_CHECKLIST.md"; marker="/tmp/claude-hygiene-hook-$(date +%Y%m%d)"; if [ ! -f "$marker" ] && [ -s "$checklist_path" ]; then checklist=$(cat "$checklist_path"); touch "$marker"; ctx="Regression hygiene reminder (first code edit today) -- full checklist below (see also docs/ARCHITECTURE_WEB.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE_BOT.md, docs/PROJECT_HISTORY_AND_THEMES.md for deeper context).\n\n${checklist}"; jq -n --arg ctx "$ctx" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":$ctx}}'; else echo '{}'; fi
